{{Stub|dialogue needs proofreading; summary missing}} {{Quest Infobox |id= 155000004 |image = Wishes in the Bell.png |type = Main |nation = Lahai-Roi |chapter = Chapter III |actNum = Segue |act = |part = |characters = Gyokuro;Hiyuki;Kanna;Lucilla;Schwarzloch |description = |requirement = |startLocation = |prev = The Flaming Red from Tomorrow |next = Starlights from Yesterdays |rewards = Union EXP*1,000;Astrite*50;Advanced Energy Core*3;Advanced Sealed Tube*3;Shell Credit*30,000 }} {{Intro/Quest}} ==Summary== {{color|old|Disclaimer: This is a compilation of Skip summary and may not reflect the accuracy of story.}} {{Description|Hiyuki arrives at the frostlands to inform Lucilla that her origami familiar failed to locate Aemeath. Lucilla assigns Hiyuki the new task of guarding the Dimmr Plains while they carry on with their plan to awaken the Exostrider, a contingency if the plan fails. To help Hiyuki fulfill that duty with a clear mind, Lucilla suggests she first return to Honami City to deal with certain matters of the heart. Hiyuki arrives in Honami and makes contact with a Black Shores agent to be briefed on the current situation before handling the deep-rooted obsessions of the Left Behind. The agent mentions that the exact whereabouts of Gyokuro, the former miko, remains unknown. A young, excited Left Behind reminisces about his admiration and dependence on the Miko of Flaming Sakura's salvation. A sorrowful Left Behind spits bitter accusations at the Miko of Flaming Sakura's failure to protect the city. While purifying the Left Behind, Hiyuki encounters a little girl named Kanna, a girl she once kne who crossed paths with both her and her older sister, Miko Gyokuro. Kanna has long since passed away, and like Hiyuki, she too lost a sister.
To comfort her, Hiyuki promises to make delicious red bean pudding together.
Kanna slowly dissipates before her eyes. Hiyuyki watches in silence, the memories of the past lingering in the quiet. The Grand Architect, disguised as a lively Left Behind, mentions her wish "That there will never be another Miko of Flaming Sakura" to Hiyuki before dropping the act.
In the confrontation, the Grand Architect reveals how Gyokuro burned through all her futures on the path to becoming miko, and that she herself had made contact with Gyokuro in the past. To unconver the truth, Hiyuki steps through a portal. An illusory Honami lies on the other side of the portal. Hiyuki is shown past conversations between Gyokuro and herself. Back then, Hiyuki was timid and reserved, while Gyokuro always embraced her with a smile. Focused on the duty of inheriting her older sister's role as miko and the ability to wield the "Suzu," the past Hiyuki rejected Gyokuro's wish to share red bean pudding with her and returned home alone.
Now, regret lingers in Hiyuki's heart: If only she had chosen to stay with her sister.}} ==Steps== # Hiyuki has been invited to the Frostlands # Go see Lucilla # Head to Honami # Purge the Left Behind # Purge the Left Behind # Purge the Left Behind # Purge the Left Behind # Continue onward # See who that familiar silhouette belongs to… # Enter the snack shop # Investigate the screen # Continue onward # See what the Grand Architect is up to # Meet the Grand Architect # Continue onward # Head to the next act # Continue onward # Sweep the obstacle in your way # Observe what the Grand Architect recorded # Use the echo painting to head to the next act # Ride the gondola # Continue onward in the gondola # See what the Grand Architect is up to # Head to the next act # Sweep the obstacle in your way # Head to the next act # See what the Grand Architect is up to # Listen to what the Grand Architect has to say ==Dialogue== {{Quest Description|Voidmatter concentration in Lahai-Roi is intensifying.
